links.outcome: Compared LLMs against simpler traditional ML baselines on same follow-up imaging classification data
links.effect: GPT-4o (Advanced) F1 = 0.832 and GPT-OSS-20B (Advanced) F1 = 0.828; LR and SVM performed strongly (F1 = 0.776 and 0.775), so simpler models remain valuable baselines.
links.quote: LR and SVM also performed strongly (F1 = 0.776 and 0.775), underscoring that while LLMs approach human-level agreement through prompt optimization, interpretable and resource-efficient models remain valuable baselines.

unlisted_practices: Task-optimized input focusing (metadata and recommendation sentences with context) to improve LLM performance
Prompt refinement to improve LLM reasoning accuracy

screen.reason: Evaluates and benchmarks multiple ML and LLM models on an annotated corpus of radiology reports for detecting imaging follow-up recommendations without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards or practices.
